note:
- The shape: one GeoJSON file per register (each entry any geometry: point, line, area) with standard properties, plus a small description file (name, territory covered, licence and credit, source, download date).
- The build reads any register generically; places matched across registers by rule (same Wikidata item, same name nearby); a declare file of your same/not-same pairs for the judgment calls.
- Today's registers converted by producers outside the app (heritage.py's function per register, federal.py's locating, crhp.py), proved to give the same heritage sites, overlays and flags, or every difference explained.
- Then deleted: the per-register code, the registers' credits in rules.rs, and the old snapshot (sources/registers/legacy).
text: Heritage registers: one GeoJSON file per register, today's registers converted, the per-register code out of the app
